name: Pushpa
subtitle: Rose & Vetiver Frizz Tamer
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A fragrant, smoothing nectar crafted to tame unruly strands and impart a delicate, floral sheen. Pushpa weaves the timeless elegance of Rose with the grounding, earthy resilience of Vetiver to calm frizz and flyaways. Suspended in a luxurious, lightweight blend of Jojoba and Argan, this botanical tamer seals the hair cuticle, wrapping each strand in moisture without the weight, leaving behind a trail of subtle, poetic aroma.

ingredients.name: Rose Petals
ingredients.role: Softens the hair and provides a calming, elegant fragrance

ingredients.name: Vetiver Roots
ingredients.role: Cools the scalp and adds earthy depth to anchor the floral notes

ingredients.name: Jojoba Seeds
ingredients.role: Mimics natural sebum to smooth frizz without greasiness

ingredients.name: Argan Nuts
ingredients.role: Seals the hair cuticle for a luminous, protected finish

whyThisHerb: Rose offers a softening touch that inherently calms flyaways, while Vetiver anchors the blend with its deep, cooling earthiness—a harmonious synergy for taming unruly hair.

howToUse.title: Warm
howToUse.description: Place two to three drops into your palms and rub them together to release the botanical aroma.

howToUse.title: Smooth
howToUse.description: Lightly graze your hands over the mid-lengths and ends of dry or damp hair to tame frizz.

howToUse.title: Polish
howToUse.description: Twist the ends slightly to seal in the moisture and add natural definition.

howToUse.title: Breathe
howToUse.description: Enjoy the lingering, grounding scent of rose and vetiver as you step out for the day.
